quests.instruction: Which shape matches a big round pizza fresh out of the oven?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of something round that has no corners at all.
quests.explanation: A pizza is round all over with no straight edges, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: A circle is perfectly round, so every point on its edge is the same distance from the middle.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a small gift box wrapped for a birthday?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape with four sides that are all the same length.
quests.explanation: A gift box like this has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: Every side of a square is exactly the same length as the others.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a slice of cheesy pizza cut from the middle?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with three straight sides and three corners.
quests.explanation: A pizza slice has three straight sides that meet at three points, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: A triangle is the only shape with just three sides and three corners.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a wooden front door with a shiny handle?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with two long sides and two short sides.
quests.explanation: A door is taller than it is wide, with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: A rectangle always has two pairs of matching sides, but they aren't all equal like a square.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a shiny coin you might find in your pocket?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of something round that can roll in every direction.
quests.explanation: A coin is perfectly round with a smooth edge, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Circles can roll smoothly because their edge has no flat parts or corners.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a single cracker on a lunch plate?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape where every side matches every other side.
quests.explanation: A cracker like this has four equal sides and four sharp corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: A square is actually a special kind of rectangle with all sides equal.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a colorful sailboat's sail catching the wind?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with three straight sides that come to a point.
quests.explanation: A sail comes to a point at the top with three straight sides, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Triangles are strong shapes, which is why you see them holding up bridges and roofs.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a chocolate bar broken into one long piece?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape that is longer on two sides than the other two.
quests.explanation: A chocolate bar is long and thin with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Rectangles are everywhere — doors, books, and phones are all rectangle-shaped.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a big yellow sun shining in the sky?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of a shape that looks the same no matter which way you turn it.
quests.explanation: The sun looks perfectly round from here on Earth, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: No matter how you spin a circle, it always looks exactly the same.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches one tile on a checkerboard floor?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape with four equal sides and four straight corners.
quests.explanation: A checkerboard tile has four matching sides and four square corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: If you spin a square a quarter turn, it looks exactly the same as before.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a tall mountain peak covered in snow?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape that starts wide at the bottom and comes to one point.
quests.explanation: A mountain peak is wide at the bottom and narrows to a single point, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: A triangle always has three corners, no matter how tall or short it looks.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a flat book lying closed on a desk?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with four corners, longer on one side than the other.
quests.explanation: A closed book is longer than it is wide, with four straight corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Rectangles have four corners that are all perfect square corners, just like a square does.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a big soap bubble floating through the air?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with a smooth curved edge and no corners.
quests.explanation: A soap bubble is perfectly round with a smooth curved edge, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Bubbles form circles because round shapes are the strongest way to hold air inside.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a folded paper napkin at a dinner table?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape where all four sides are exactly the same length.
quests.explanation: A folded napkin has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: Squares are so balanced that you can fold one in half four different ways and it still matches.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a pointy party hat worn at a celebration?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with three sides that meet together at the top.
quests.explanation: A party hat is wide at the bottom and comes to a point at the top, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Triangles are the only shape that can never bend out of shape once the sides are set.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a flat-screen television on the wall?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with four corners and two sides longer than the others.
quests.explanation: A television screen is wider than it is tall, with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Most screens — TVs, phones, and tablets — are shaped like rectangles.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a round steering wheel in a car?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of a shape you could spin around and around forever.
quests.explanation: A steering wheel is round all the way around, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Wheels are circles because a round shape rolls smoothly without bumping.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a single waffle square fresh off the iron?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape with four matching sides, like a tiny box.
quests.explanation: A waffle square has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: A square looks the same whether you flip it, spin it, or turn it upside down.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a warning road sign that means yield?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with three points, one at the very top.
quests.explanation: A yield sign has three straight sides meeting at three points, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Road signs often use triangles because the pointed shape catches a driver's eye.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a brick used to build a garden wall?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape that is longer than it is tall, with four corners.
quests.explanation: A brick is longer on two sides than the other two, with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Builders love rectangle bricks because they stack together neatly in rows.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a warm round cookie fresh from the oven?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with one smooth curved edge and no corners.
quests.explanation: A cookie is round all over with no straight edges, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: A circle has no corners at all, which is why it can spin in place forever.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a single square cracker stacked in a box?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape shaped exactly like a tiny, even box.
quests.explanation: A square cracker has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: If you measure every side of a square, they will always match perfectly.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a musical triangle instrument you ring with a stick?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape made from three straight metal sides.
quests.explanation: A musical triangle is bent into three straight sides meeting at three corners, just like the shape triangle!
quests.funFact: The triangle instrument got its name because it is shaped exactly like the triangle shape.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a long envelope waiting to be mailed?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape longer on two sides than the other two, with four corners.
quests.explanation: An envelope is longer than it is tall, with four straight corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Rectangles are a favorite shape for envelopes because letters slide in easily.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a big round clock hanging on the wall?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with a curved edge that goes all the way around.
quests.explanation: A clock face is round all the way around, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Clocks are often circles because the hands can spin smoothly around the middle.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a windowpane with four equal sides?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape where every side is exactly as long as the next.
quests.explanation: This windowpane has four matching sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: A square has four right-angle corners, meaning each corner forms a perfect L shape.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a crunchy nacho chip ready for dipping?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with three straight edges and three points.
quests.explanation: A nacho chip has three straight sides meeting at three corners, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Triangles are one of the strongest shapes, which is why chip makers love this design.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a laptop computer screen?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape wider than it is tall, with four straight corners.
quests.explanation: A laptop screen is wider than it is tall, with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Rectangles are a popular shape for screens because they fit words and pictures neatly.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a colorful frisbee flying through the park?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of a shape that spins smoothly with no corners to catch the wind.
quests.explanation: A frisbee is round all over with a smooth curved edge, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Frisbees fly well because their round shape spins evenly through the air.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a bathroom floor tile with four matching sides?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape where all four sides are the exact same length.
quests.explanation: This floor tile has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: Square tiles fit together perfectly with no gaps, covering a whole floor neatly.
